description: This file defines an interface 'X509CertificateChainValidator' for validating X.509 certificate chains within the Eclipse Hono project's authentication service. It declares methods for validating certificate chains against trust anchors and trust anchor lists, returning asynchronous results via Vert.x Future objects.

classes.name: X509CertificateChainValidator
classes.description: An interface providing methods for validating X.509 certificate chains against trust anchors, to be implemented by classes handling certificate validation logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a certificate chain against a specified trust anchor, returning a Future that completes successfully if valid or fails with a CertificateException.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a certificate chain against a list of trust anchors, returning a Future that completes successfully if valid or fails with a CertificateException.
